kurzfassung: This episode is dedicated to remembering the events of September 11, 2001. It honors those who served and those who lost their lives on that day. Listeners hear firsthand stories from firefighters and families of the victims.

beschreibung:
On today's episode we are remembering those to served and those who lost their lives on September 11th, 2001. We hear stories from firefighters themselves and families of those who we have lost.
